item.title: CLANNAD Café Sparks Backlash Over $14 Fish Dinner
item.description: An upcoming CLANNAD collaboration café celebrating Nagisa Furukawa’s birthday in Japan has attracted criticism after revealing a ¥2,200 ($14) fish dinner, with fans questioning why an ordinary-looking Japanese meal costs so much.

item.title: Majutsu wo Kiwamete Tabi Reincarnates as an Elf

item.title: Japan’s Teacher Shortage Forces Educators to Work Long Hours
item.description: Public schools in Japan’s Saga Prefecture have struggled with persistent teacher shortages, leaving existing staff responsible for additional classes, administrative duties, and lesson preparation that often continues late into the evening.

item.title: Traditional Matchmaking Makes a Comeback Among Young Japanese
item.description: Frustration with dating apps is encouraging some younger Japanese singles to embrace traditional arranged introductions, with professional matchmaking services, parental assistance, and AI-powered recommendations offering alternative paths to marriage.

item.title: Disney Embraces AI for Animation, Movies & Theme Parks
item.description: Disney is expanding its use of artificial intelligence across animation, film production, streaming, and theme parks, marking a significant shift for a company that previously challenged AI developers over copyright infringement.

item.title: US Police Warn Grand Theft Auto VI Players Not to Commit Crimes in Real Life
item.description: Police departments across the United States have issued warnings following the release of Grand Theft Auto VI, reminding players that real-world crimes have consequences and that officers aren’t video game NPCs.

item.title: YouTuber’s Stalker Beaten to Death After Demanding Marriage
item.description: A 28-year-old man who allegedly broke into Indian YouTuber Neha Bisht’s home and demanded she marry him has died following an assault by her family and neighbors. Two suspects, including Bisht’s father, have been arrested.
